name: Regression: Mark Ferrari palette cycling maintains 60 FPS without polluting undo history buffers
description: Verify that running live palette cycling updates color lookup tables dynamically without mutating underlying raster buffers or pushing phantom undo states to the history engine.

planSteps.description: Click on the center drawing canvas to paint a stroke
Click the Palette tab button in the right inspector panel, then switch to the 'Cycle Engine' sub-tab
Click the 'Play Cycle' toggle button and let it run
Verify the palette cycling engine actively shifts color lookup registers
Click 'Pause Cycle' to stop dynamic cycling
Click the Undo button in the top header or press Ctrl+Z
Verify the undo action completes cleanly
